name: KOI Notification ID
description: The KOI notification_event_id for this alert — the only per-alert identity KOI emits. Written by 'KOI IR - Extract Alert Context' and used by 'KOI IR - Alert Triage' to detect duplicates: KOI re-sends every still-open alert on each fetch (measured ~709x over 7 days), so without this the same alert is investigated many times over. Note koi_event_id is the scan batch and finding_uid is the policy definition; neither is per-alert.
